blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.
blocks.zh: 病理学的深层学习方法受到大规模像素级说明的有限可用性和高成本的限制. 合成数据可以缓解这种局限性,但现有的管道往往缺乏可靠的质量控制,并且仍然与下游分析连接薄弱. 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个三阶段框架,将自动数据筛选、基因表达学习和高效适应下游任务结合起来。 首先,我们开发了一个病理学代理系统,以评估图像质量和过滤样品,结果产生了TCGA-200K,一个数据集,包含从公共TCGA寄存器中选择的217,030个病理学补丁. 第二,我们在筛选数据上培养基因模型。 除了图像合成外,它的骨干还学习了结构及语义表现,这些表现可以转移给下游任务. 第三,我们利用轻量级任务特定头部,使预先训练的基因骨干适应语义分裂. 我们进一步引入了PathSeg-380K,一个语义分类数据集,其中对12个细胞类型的约38万个细胞有专家说明. 对多种病理数据集的实验表明,拟议框架实现了最先进的分解性能. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath公开查阅。

blocks.en: Histopathological examination is a cornerstone of clinical diagnosis and disease assessment [ 1 ] . Advances in deep learning have further expanded the capabilities of computational pathology, supporting applications ranging from nuclei segmentation [ 2 ] and tumor detection [ 3 ] to tissue classification [ 4 ] . However, these models often rely on large-scale expert annotations [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Obtaining such annotations is costly and time-consuming, as accurate labeling requires pathologists to manually identify and delineate complex cellular structures [ 8 ] . As a result, sufficiently annotated datasets remain scarce in many clinical settings [ 9 ] , increasing the risk of overfitting and limiting model generalization.
blocks.zh: 组织病理学检查是临床诊断和疾病评估的基石 [1]. 深入学习的进步进一步扩大了计算病理学的能力,支持应用范围从核分裂[2]和肿瘤检测[3]到组织分类[4]. 然而,这些模型往往依赖于大规模专家说明[5,6,7]. 获得这种说明是昂贵和费时的,因为准确的标签要求病理学家手动识别和划定复杂的细胞结构[8]。 因此,在许多临床环境下,充分注解的数据集仍然很少[9],增加了过度调整和限制模型通化的风险.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the proposed unified three-stage framework. In Stage I, an agent-driven screening pipeline evaluates pathology patches from multiple quality dimensions and selects high-quality samples to construct the TCGA-200K dataset. In Stage II, the curated data are used to learn pathology-specific generative priors through DiT blocks. In Stage III, the learned generative priors are transferred to downstream segmentation on PanNuke and PathSeg-380K, where the pretrained backbone provides multi-level pathology representations for accurate pathology segmentation.

blocks.en: Synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising strategy to augment scarce labeled data [ 10 ] . Generative models, including generative adversarial networks (GANs) [ 11 ] and diffusion models [ 12 ] , have demonstrated strong capability in synthesizing realistic pathology images. Typically, these generated images are combined with the existing datasets to augment the training pool, thereby improving the performance of downstream tasks such as segmentation [ 13 ] . However, it still faces two major limitations. (1) Existing pipelines lack effective data quality control. In the pathology area, images frequently suffer from staining artifacts, blurred structures, and poor cellular visibility [ 14 , 15 ] . For example, within a single whole slide image (WSI), many regions are often uninformative for diagnosis. Training generative models on such low-quality data without quality assessment leads to unreliable synthetic images with inaccurate pathological patterns [ 16 ] . (2) The generation process and downstream tasks are disconnected from each other. Existing methods treat generative models merely as black-box data engines to sample new images. Therefore, they fail to leverage the rich semantic information learned during the generation process [ 17 ] . Our experiments reveal that the generative model backbone itself can serve as a powerful feature extractor for downstream tasks, providing rich prior information.
blocks.zh: 合成数据生成已成为一项有希望的战略,可以增加贴有标签的稀缺数据[10]。 基因模型,包括基因对抗网络(GANs)[11]和扩散模型[12],在合成现实病理学图像方面表现出了很强的能力. 通常情况下,这些生成的图像与现有的数据集相结合,以扩大培训库,从而改进分解等下游任务的执行情况[13]。 然而,它仍然面临两大限制。 (1) 现有管道缺乏有效的数据质量控制。 在病理学领域,图像经常会受污迹文物,结构模糊,细胞能见度差[14,15]. 例如,在一个单一的整体幻灯片图像(WSI)中,许多区域往往不适于诊断。 在未经质量评估的情况下,对此类低质量数据的基因模型进行培训,会导致不可靠的合成图像和不准确的病理模式[16]. (2)生成过程和下游任务相互脱节. 现有方法将基因模型仅仅当作黑盒数据引擎来取取取新图像. 因此,它们未能利用在生成过程中学到的丰富的语义信息[17]. 我们的实验表明,基因模型骨干本身可以作为下游任务的强大特征提取器,提供丰富的前置信息.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel three-stage framework that unifies automated data quality control, the learning of high-quality generative priors, and transfer learning for downstream tasks. First, we introduce an agent-based screening mechanism for dataset refinement. We design an intelligent pathology agent system to automatically evaluate and score the quality of pathology images across multiple clinical dimensions. Only high-scoring images are retained to construct a curated training set for learning the generative prior. Second, we train a generative model on this refined dataset. Crucially, this model is not deployed merely to synthesize new data; instead, its backbone naturally extracts rich structural and semantic information during the generative training process, allowing it to serve as a powerful foundational encoder. Third, we redefine downstream analysis as a transfer learning paradigm. By simply appending a lightweight task-specific head (e.g., for semantic segmentation) to the pre-trained generative backbone, our framework leverages these learned priors with minimal training overhead. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • A Unified Three-Stage Framework. We identify that current pathology analysis pipelines suffer from inadequate data quality control and a disconnect between generation and downstream tasks. To address this, we propose a novel framework that unifies agent-guided quality screening, robust generative prior learning, and efficient downstream transfer learning. • Two Novel High-Quality Datasets. We construct and introduce two large-scale datasets to the community: TCGA-200K, comprising 217,030 premium pathology patches curated from the open-source TCGA repository using our agent-based screening mechanism. We also use PathSeg-380K for semantic segmentation. It contains annotations provided by two clinical pathologists for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. • State-of-the-Art Performance. Extensive experiments show that our framework generates high-quality pathology images. When the pretrained generative backbone is transferred to semantic segmentation, the resulting model also outperforms existing segmentation methods across both public and private datasets, indicating that the learned generative prior benefits both image synthesis and downstream pathology analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了一个新的三阶段框架,统一自动化数据质量控制,学习高质量的遗传学前科,并为下游任务转让学习。 首先,我们采用基于代理人的筛选机制来完善数据集。 我们设计了一个智能病理学代理系统,可以自动地对跨多个临床维度的病理学图像质量进行评估和评分. 只有高分图像被保留下来,用于构建一套用于学习先入为主的培训。 其次,我们在这个精细的数据集上培养出基因模型。 关键是,这个模型的部署并不仅仅是为了合成出新的数据;相反,它的骨干在基因培养过程中自然地提取出丰富的结构和语义信息,使得它能够作为一个强大的基础编码器. 第三,我们把下游分析重新定义为转移学习模式。 通过简单地将一个轻量级任务特定头(例如语义分化)附加到预先训练的基因骨干上,我们的框架用最低限度的训练管理费来利用这些学到的前科。 我们的贡献概述如下: 一个统一的三阶段框架。 我们确认,目前的病理分析管道因数据质量控制不足和生成任务与下游任务脱节而受到影响。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个新颖的框架,这个框架统一了由代理人指导的质量筛选、强健的先遗传学和高效的下游转移学。 • 两个小说高品质数据集。 我们在社区中构建和引入了两个大型数据集:TCGA-200K,由217,030个溢出病理学补丁组成,由开源TCGA寄存器利用我们的代理筛选机制来进行校正. 我们还使用PathSeg-380K进行语义分解. 它包含了两位临床病理学家为12个细胞类型的约380,000个细胞提供的说明. • 艺术表现。 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架会产生高质量的病理图像. 当先入为主的基因骨干被转移到语义分解时,所形成的模型也超越了公共和私人数据集的现有分解方法,表明所学的基因分解之前既有利于图像合成又有利于下游病理分析.

To address this, we propose a novel framework that unifies agent-guided quality screening, robust generative prior learning, and efficient downstream transfer learning.

We construct and introduce two large-scale datasets to the community: TCGA-200K, comprising 217,030 premium pathology patches curated from the open-source TCGA repository using our agent-based screening mechanism. We also use PathSeg-380K for semantic segmentation. It contains annotations provided by two clinical pathologists for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types.

blocks.en: I-A Synthetic Data for Pathology
blocks.zh: I-A 病理学合成数据

blocks.en:
Acquiring massive and fully annotated pathology datasets is frequently constrained by privacy concerns and high costs [ 18 ] . To address this data scarcity, researchers have actively explored synthetic data generation [ 19 ] . While models such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models have achieved notable progress in producing visually realistic images [ 20 , 21 ] , a critical limitation persists. Current approaches largely neglect the rigorous filtering of data sources [ 22 , 23 ] . Consequently, incorporating training images of poor quality inevitably introduces erroneous information into the generative models.
As a result, the synthesized images may fail to preserve key pathological structures, reducing their usefulness for downstream medical tasks.
blocks.zh:
获取大量和充分注解的病理数据集常常受到隐私关切和高成本的限制[18]. 为解决这一数据稀缺问题,研究人员已积极探索合成数据的生成[19]. 虽然Generative Aversarial Networks(GANs)等模型和传播模型在制作视觉现实相片[20,21]方面取得了显著进展,但关键限制仍然存在. 目前的办法在很大程度上忽略了严格过滤数据来源[22、23]。 因此,将质量差的培训图像纳入基因模型必然会引入错误信息。
因此,被合成的图像可能无法保存出关键的病理结构,从而降低了其对下游医疗任务的用处.

blocks.en: I-B Agents in Pathology
blocks.zh: I-B 病理学代理人

blocks.en: The reasoning capabilities of AI agents have opened new frontiers in medical image analysis [ 24 ] . These agents have shown remarkable potential in automating complex diagnostic workflows, including pathological image interpretation, report generation, and interactive clinical decision-making [ 25 ] . By simulating the reasoning processes of human experts, agents can analyze intricate tissue morphologies and cellular patterns. Despite their growing success in diagnostic tasks, the ability of agents to guide pathological image generation remains largely unexplored [ 26 ] . Specifically, they can act as virtual experts, providing feedback on image quality and structural validity, which offers a promising avenue for enhancing the reliability of synthetic medical data. Motivated by this gap, we introduce a novel framework that leverages agentic reasoning to screen and guide pathological image synthesis.
blocks.zh: AI特工的推理能力在医学影像分析中开辟了新的前沿[24]. 这些物剂在使复杂的诊断工作流程自动化方面表现出了显著的潜力,包括病理图像解析,报告生成,以及交互式临床决策[25]. 通过模拟人类专家的推理过程,物剂可以分析复杂的组织形态和细胞形态. 尽管在诊断任务上越来越成功,但物剂指导病态图像生成的能力基本上仍未被探讨[26]. 具体而言,他们可以作为虚拟专家,提供关于图像质量和结构有效性的反馈,这为提高合成医疗数据的可靠性提供了一个有希望的途径。 以这个差距为动力,我们引入了一种新的框架,利用代理推理来筛选和指导病态图像合成.

blocks.en: I-C Pathology Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: I- C 病理学图像分解

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation is widely used in computational pathology to delineate cellular structures and tissue regions [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . Some methods train segmentation networks from scratch on task-specific datasets, but limited pixel-level annotations often lead to overfitting [ 31 ] . Others adopt backbones pretrained on natural images, such as ResNet [ 32 ] and DINO [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] , whose representations do not fully capture pathology-specific morphology [ 37 ] . Pathology foundation models provide stronger domain-specific features [ 38 , 39 ] , yet they are designed as encoders and cannot support image generation. We instead pretrain a generative model on agent-curated pathology images and transfer its multi-level features to semantic segmentation, allowing the same generative prior to serve both image synthesis and downstream analysis.
blocks.zh: 语义分解在计算病理学中被广泛用于划分细胞结构和组织区域[27,28,29,30]. 一些方法从零开始在任务特定数据集上训练分块网络,但有限的像素级说明往往导致过度配齐 [31]. 其他采用在自然图像上预先被训练出骨干,如ResNet[32]和DINO[33,34,35,36],其表现不能完全捕捉出病理特有的形态[37]. 病理基础模型提供了更强大的域特有特征[38,39],然而它们被设计为编码器,无法支持图像生成. 相反,我们在物剂测定的病理影像上预演了基因模型,并将其多层次特征转移到语义分解上,使同样的基因分解在既服务于影像合成又服务于下游分析之前.

blocks.en: II-A Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we propose a unified three-stage framework that tightly integrates automated data quality control, generative prior learning, and downstream segmentation. First, we introduce an agent-driven screening mechanism to evaluate and filter raw pathology patches, yielding a highly curated, large-scale dataset (TCGA-200K). Second, we leverage this refined dataset to train a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) via Flow Matching, enabling the backbone to learn robust structural and semantic generative priors rather than serving merely as a data synthesizer. Finally, we reformulate downstream semantic segmentation as a transfer learning paradigm, where a lightweight multi-level decoder is appended to the pre-trained DiT backbone to map the extracted multi-scale features to precise pixel-level predictions. The effectiveness and generalization ability of this unified pipeline are comprehensively validated on both the public PanNuke dataset and our newly proposed PathSeg-380K dataset.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们提出了一个统一的三阶段框架,严格地将自动数据质量控制、先入为主的学习和下游分化结合起来。 首先,我们采用由代理人驱动的筛选机制来评价和过滤原始病理学补丁,生成一个高度精密的大规模数据集(TCGA-200K). 第二,我们利用这个精细的数据集,通过"流相匹配"(Flow Matching)来训练一个分化变形器(DiT),使骨干能够学习强健的结构性和语义基因前科,而不是仅仅充当数据合成器. 最后,我们将下游语义分解重构为一种转移学习范式,其中轻量级多层解码器被附加在预先训练的DiT主干线上,将所提取的多尺度特性映射到精确的像素级预测. 公共PanNuke数据集和我们新提议的PathSeg-380K数据集都全面验证了这一统一管道的有效性和通俗化能力。

blocks.en: II-B Stage I: Agent-Driven Pathology Data Curation
blocks.zh: II-B 第一阶段:代理驱动病理学数据校正

blocks.en: Current generative modeling in pathology is constrained by two major challenges: the limited scale of existing datasets, which often contain only a few thousand images, and the lack of rigorous quality control. As a result, low-quality samples, such as patches with sparse cellular content or out-of-focus blur, can substantially degrade model performance. To address this, we propose an agent-driven and scalable quality curation pipeline with a semi-supervised design. Specifically, we first construct a large-scale pathology dataset, denoted as 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , from multiple public TCGA cohorts [ 40 ] , and partition it into a small labeled pilot set 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{P} and a large unlabeled pool 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{U} . A Multi-dimensional Assessment Pathology Expert Agent is then employed to annotate 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{P} across three key quality dimensions, providing supervision for training a lightweight regressor. The trained regressor is subsequently used to score the much larger unlabeled pool 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{U} , enabling scalable quality estimation in a semi-supervised manner. Finally, a multi-dimensional quantile filtering strategy is applied to extract a high-fidelity subset 𝒟 ∗ \mathcal{D}^{*} , resulting in TCGA-200K , a curated dataset of over 200,000 high-quality pathology patches for generative modeling.
blocks.zh: 目前病理学中的基因模型化受到两大挑战的制约:现有数据集规模有限,往往只包含几千个图像;缺乏严格的质量控制. 因此,低质量的样本,如细胞含量稀少的补丁或焦外模糊等,可以使模型性能被大幅度地降解. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用由代理驱动和可伸缩的质量校正管道,采用半监督设计。 具体地说,我们首先从多个公共 TCGA 组群中构建一个大规模病理数据集, 表示为 D\ mathcal{D} , 并将其分割成一个带有标签的小型飞行员集 D P\ mathcal{D}_{P} 和一个大型无标签的池 D U\ mathcal{D}_{U} 。 然后使用一个多维评估病理专家代理, 在三个关键质量维度上对 D P\ mathcal{D}_{P} 进行注释, 提供对训练轻量级退步器的监督 。 训练有素的后退器随后被用来评分更大的无标签池 D U\mathcal{D}_{U},从而能够以半监督的方式进行可扩展的质量估计. 最后,采用了多维分解过滤策略来取出高真分集 D *\ mathcal{D}^{*}},从而产生了TCGA-200K,一个由超过20万个高质病理补丁组成的编译数据集来进行基因建模.

blocks.en: II-B 1 Large-Scale Pathology Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: II-B 1 大型病理数据集建设

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), we source a diverse set of Whole Slide Images (WSIs) across five cancer types from TCGA: Breast Invasive Carcinoma (BRCA), Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma (CESC), Colon Adenocarcinoma (COAD), Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (KIRC), and Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (LIHC). We employ the CLAM toolkit [ 41 ] to process these WSIs into a comprehensive dataset 𝒟 \mathcal{D} containing approximately 14 million 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches. While this preprocessing effectively removes the majority of the white background regions, the retained patches inevitably exhibit localized artifacts (e.g., tissue folding, out-of-focus blurring, and uneven staining) that can destabilize training dynamics. To facilitate our agent-driven quality curation, we randomly partition the full dataset 𝒟 \mathcal{D} into two disjoint subsets: a small pilot set 𝒟 P \mathcal{D}_{P} and a massive unannotated target pool 𝒟 U \mathcal{D}_{U} .
blocks.zh: 如图1(a)所示,我们从TCGA从五种癌症类型中源出一套不同的全幻灯片图像: 乳腺侵入性癌(BRCA),子宫颈积分细胞癌(CESC),Colon Adenocarcinoma(COAD),肾上腺清细胞癌(KIRC)和活体肝细胞癌(LIHC). 我们使用 CLAM 工具包 [41] ,将这些WSI 处理成一个综合数据集 D\ mathcal{D},其中包含大约1400万个256x256\times 256个补丁. 虽然这种预处理有效去除了大部分白色背景区域,但所保留的补丁不可避免地会展示出局部的文物(如组织折叠,焦点外模糊,以及不均匀的污渍等),会破坏训练动态的稳定. 为了方便我们代理人驱动的质量校正,我们随机将完整的数据集 D\ mathcal{D} 分割成两个脱节子集: 一个小型的飞行员集 D P\ mathcal{D}_{P} 和一个巨大的无附加说明的目标池 D U\mathcal{D}_{U} 。

blocks.en: III-B Implementation Details

blocks.en: In Stage II, we train the pathology generative prior using a DiT backbone with the objective defined in Equation 7 . The model takes 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches as input, featuring a patch size of 8 8 , an embedding dimension of 768, 12 Transformer blocks, and 12 attention heads. We employ the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . The model is trained for 200,000 iterations with a total batch size of 16. In Stage III, the segmentation framework is initialized with the DiT backbone pretrained in Stage II. We optimize the network using AdamW, explicitly applying a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} to the backbone and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} to the newly initialized segmentation head. To ensure fair evaluation, we employ a 3-fold cross-validation strategy, training the model for 20 epochs per fold using the loss function defined in Eq. 12 . All experiments are conducted in parallel across four NVIDIA A6000 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们先用一个DiT骨干来训练病理基因,目标在方程式7中确定。 模型取出256×256256\times 256个补丁作为输入,以补丁尺寸为8·8为特色,嵌入维度为768个,12个变形器块,12个注意力头. 我们使用 AdamW 优化器, 学习率为 1× 10− 4 1\times 10× 4} 体重衰减为 1× 10− 4 1\times 10× 4}。 该型号为20万次迭代所训练,总批量尺寸为16. 在第三阶段,分解框架由第二阶段预先培训的DiT主干部分初始化。 我们利用AdamW优化网络,明确将1×10−5 1\times 10×5}的学习率应用到骨干上,将3×10−4 3\times 10×4}应用到新初始化的分头. 为确保公平评价,我们采用了3倍的交叉验证策略,利用Eq.12定义的损失函数,对每折叠20个时段的模型进行培训。 所有实验都同时在四个NVIDIA A6000 GPU进行.

blocks.en: III-C Reliability of Agent-based Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 三-C 以代理人为基础的质量评估的可靠性

blocks.en: We implement the pathology expert agent using GPT-4.1 mini (“gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14”) and evaluate its scoring reliability on an independent set of 600 pathology patches, which are excluded from the pilot set used to train the quality regressor. Two pathologists independently assess each patch in terms of cell presence, stain quality, and histologic clarity. Samples with a score difference of two or more points are jointly reviewed to obtain the final consensus score. We use the pathologist consensus as the reference and report Spearman’s correlation [ 56 ] for each quality dimension. Mean absolute error (MAE) and quadratic weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 57 ] are averaged across the three dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4.1迷你(“gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14”)实施病理学专家剂,并在600个病理学补丁的独立集上评估其分数可靠性,这些补丁被排除在用于训练质量退步器的试验集之外。 两位病理学家从细胞的存在,污点质量,以及组织清晰度等方面独立评估了每个补丁. 得分相差为2分或2分以上的样本,由联合审查,以获得最终共识分. 我们用病理学家的共识作为参考, 平均绝对误差(MAE)和四相加权的 Cohen ox\kappa [57] 均分三个维度。

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , the two pathologists show consistent assessments, with Spearman’s correlations above 0.81 and an average weighted κ \kappa of 0.827. The agent reaches correlations of 0.782, 0.811, and 0.829 for cell presence, stain quality, and histologic clarity, respectively. Its average MAE is 0.326, while the weighted κ \kappa against the pathologist consensus is 0.814, close to the agreement between the two pathologists. The quality regressor shows a small decrease against the consensus, with an MAE of 0.378 and a weighted κ \kappa of 0.789. Meanwhile, its correlations with the agent are all above 0.90, with an MAE of 0.170 and a weighted κ \kappa of 0.912. These results indicate that the regressor closely reproduces the agent scores while retaining strong agreement with pathologist assessment, supporting its use for large-scale patch screening.

blocks.en: III-D Effect of Agent-based Data Curation
blocks.zh: 以代理为基础的数据校正的效果

blocks.en: We evaluate generation quality using FID [ 58 ] , KID [ 59 ] , and Mean Opinion Score (MOS), where lower FID and KID and higher MOS indicate better quality. MOS is independently assessed by two pathologists on a five-point scale, with “1” and “5” indicating the lowest and highest quality, respectively, and their average score is reported. For each curation setting, we train the generative model on the corresponding retained subset, generate 10,000 pathology images, and compute FID and KID against real images. Downstream utility is evaluated by transferring the learned backbone to PanNuke under the same segmentation protocol, with mIoU as the metric. In Table III , From Scratch denotes the full segmentation architecture with a randomly initialized DiT backbone and the same multi-level decoder, while w/o Agent (100%) denotes generative pretraining on the complete unfiltered training set. For the remaining settings, an image is retained only when its predicted scores for cell presence, stain quality, and histologic clarity simultaneously fall within the top 75%, 50%, 25%, 10%, or 5% of their respective distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们使用FID[58]、KID[59]和Mean Opture Score(MOS)来评价生成质量,其中FID和KID较低和MOS较高显示质量更好。 卫生部由两名病理学家按五分制独立评估,“1”和“5”分别表示质量最低和最高,并报告其平均得分。 对于每次的校正设置,我们都会在相应的保留子集上训练出基因模型,生成一万个病态图像,并对照真实图像计算出FID和KID. 下游公用通过根据同分化协议将所学骨干转移到PanNuke来评价,以mIoU为度量. 在表三中,"出自分解"(From Scratch)表示带有随机初始化的DiT主干线和同为多级解码器的完整分解架构,而"w/o Agent"(100%)则表示对完整未过滤的训练集进行基因预训. 对于其余的设置,只有当其对细胞存在,污点质量,以及组织清晰度的预测得分同时属于各自分布的75%,50%,25%,10%或5%时,图像才会被保留.

blocks.en: Using the complete unfiltered dataset yields an FID of 38.75, a KID of 0.056, and an MOS of 3.12. Agent-based curation generally improves generation quality as the selection criterion becomes stricter. In particular, requiring samples to rank within the top 10% in each quality dimension reduces FID and KID to 23.96 and 0.021, respectively, while achieving the highest MOS of 4.43. Further tightening the threshold to the top 5% improves FID and KID to 23.11 and 0.019, but slightly decreases MOS to 4.41. These results indicate that training with higher-ranked samples improves distributional fidelity and pathological plausibility.
blocks.zh: 使用完整的未过滤数据集得出38.75的FID,0.056的KID和3.12的MOS. 由于选择标准更加严格,基于代理的校正一般会提高生成质量。 特别是,要求样本在每个质量维度中排在前10%,将FID和KID分别降至23.96和0.021,同时达到最高的MOS为4.43. 进一步将门槛收紧到前5%,使FID和KID提高到23.11和0.019,但略微将MOS降到了4.41. 这些结果表明,使用排名较高的样本的培训提高了分布忠诚度和病理可信性。

blocks.en: The downstream results show a similar trend. Training the segmentation model from scratch achieves an mIoU of 47.19%, while transferring the generative prior trained without agent-based curation increases it to 53.41%. Using the prior trained on samples ranked within the top 10% in each quality dimension further improves mIoU to 55.46%, corresponding to gains of 8.27 and 2.05 percentage points over the two settings, respectively. Although the top 5% setting achieves the best FID and KID, its mIoU decreases to 55.03%, suggesting that overly strict filtering may reduce the diversity needed for transferable representation learning. We therefore adopt the top 10% setting in subsequent experiments.
blocks.zh: 下游的结果表明类似趋势。 从零开始培训分化模型的mIoU比例为47.19%,而转移基因前经过培训但没有以剂为主的分化方法则将分化率提高到53.41%。 利用每个质量层面排名在前10%的样本培训,mIoU进一步提高到55.46%,这两个环境分别提高了8.27%和2.05个百分点。 虽然前5%的设置达到了最好的FID和KID,但其mIoU下降到了55.03%,这表明过于严格的过滤可能会降低可转移代表学习所需的多样性. 因此,我们在以后的实验中采用了前10%的设定。

blocks.en: III-F 1 Module Ablation

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of each component, we conduct the ablation study shown in Table IV . The Baseline uses a randomly initialized DiT with an MLP head. Introducing the pretrained generative prior in M1 improves mIoU by 7.59 and 7.85 percentage points on PanNuke and PathSeg-380K, respectively. Starting from M1, M2 and M3 separately introduce Agent Screening and the multi-level decoder. Agent Screening improves mIoU by 1.68 and 1.64 points, while the multi-level decoder yields gains of 1.24 and 1.11 points and reduces mASD from 25.86 to 24.01 on PanNuke and from 6.58 to 5.51 on PathSeg-380K. Combining all components achieves the best performance on both datasets, reaching mIoUs of 55.46% and 55.45% and mASDs of 22.91 and 4.81, respectively. These results demonstrate that agent-based data curation and multi-level feature fusion provide complementary benefits to the generative prior.

Through AdaLN [ 49 ] , smaller values emphasize local textures and cellular details, whereas larger values favor more abstract tissue semantics. We therefore investigate the optimal balance between spatial detail and semantic abstraction.

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we presented an agent-driven framework that integrates pathology data curation, generative prior learning, and downstream semantic segmentation. The pathology expert agent enables scalable quality screening and the construction of the curated TCGA-200K dataset. Using these high-quality samples, the DiT backbone learns pathology-specific representations that capture both cellular morphology and tissue-level semantics, which are effectively transferred to a lightweight segmentation head. Strong results on PanNuke and PathSeg-380K demonstrate the value of generative pretraining for both pathology image synthesis and downstream analysis, while future work will extend the framework to other clinically relevant tasks, including classification and survival analysis.
We will also investigate more efficient agent-based curation strategies to reduce screening costs while preserving data quality across institutions and staining protocols.

在这部作品中,我们提出了一种由物剂驱动的框架,将病理数据解析,基因前学和下游语义分解结合起来. 病理学专家代理可以进行可伸缩的质量筛选并建造了所编译的TCGA-200K数据集. DiT骨干利用这些高品质的样本来学习病理学上特有的表现,既能捕捉到细胞形态,又能捕捉到组织层次的语义,这些语义被有效转移到轻量级分化头. 关于PanNuke和PathSeg-380K的有力结果显示了基因前训练对病理图像合成和下游分析的价值,而今后的工作将扩展框架,使其包括分类和生存分析在内的其他临床相关任务.
我们还将调查更有效的以代理人为基础的管理战略,以减少筛选费用,同时保持各机构的数据质量和污渍协议。
